reason: I already paid for salon software once and my staff never touched it, so I cancelled. This one is only in English, and my stylists will not type bills in English on their phones, so I would be paying ₹4,999 plus ₹999 a month for the same story again.
objection: My staff will not use it, especially when it is only in English. The register and WhatsApp work for us, and I do not want to throw away another setup fee.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked fully in Hindi, there was no setup fee or it was refundable, and they showed me my staff actually using it during the free month.
